revisions.reason: Initial band crossed shoe tops rather than soles
revisions.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / scientific-educational.
Input1 edit target seated band row; input2 canonical identity.
Correct only BAND ROUTING and grip separation. Band must be securely LOOPED AROUND THE SOLES of both shoes at midfoot, with its central bridge OUTSIDE and beyond the soles, NOT stretched across tops/laces. The two tension strands run from left/right SIDE EDGES of the feet back toward the corresponding left/right hands. Show clear turnaround at each outer sole edge, attached by continuous band across underside of soles, not attached to upper shoe fabric. Feet held dorsiflexed so band won't slip. Keep hands distinctly apart beside waist, each grips its own end, elbows pulled back. Preserve seated pose, neutral upright torso, soft knees, foot positions if possible, same anatomy/highlights/style/backdrop/fullframe. No new anchor.
